narr: A cold front moved into the region and stalled while a weakness aloft lingered over area. This provided multiple days of rain while soils were already saturated from previous events. Flash flooded resulted from the prolonged rain.
ev: Heavy rain over southern sections of Alexandria flooded and closed several roads in the city. Multiple cars flooded and at least one home also took water.
Waterways between Dequincy and Westlake overflowed closing some roadways.
Heavy rain caused drainage ditches to overflow in southwest Lake Charles. This briefly closed a few roads.
Heavy rain briefly flooded a few roadways near Grand Lake.
Heavy rain flooded numerous streets in Lafayette including Johnson Street and the roads through the ULL campus.
A very high rainfall rate produced street flooding in Westlake and Sulphur. Five to six inches of rain fell in around 1 hour.
